target_contract.selection: Exact high-depth Japan38 concepts used in the n>=5 continuous-lightness history diagnostic; retain observations with nonmissing corolla_lab_lightness_median.

operational_japan_archipelago_window_v1.reason: The source observation table has coordinates but no country field. The window is a transparent coordinate heuristic for sensitivity analysis, not an authoritative national-boundary classification.
operational_japan_archipelago_window_v1.known_target_behavior: For the six focal taxa the heuristic excludes all C. verutum observations in the Himalaya and all C. pendulum observations in Korea/continental northeast Asia, while retaining the Hokkaido subset of C. kamtschaticum.

claim_boundary: This is a geographic-provenance sensitivity layer. Exact taxon-name matching does not imply that a global species-level image median represents the phenotype of the Japanese population attached to the nuclear tip.
